manifest_row.title: Clues to the impact of climate change may seep from a volcano in Costa Rica

screening.main_topic: Research into how volcanic carbon dioxide emissions may affect tropical forest growth and the forests’ role as a carbon sink under climate change.
screening.climate_relevance: The article directly addresses uncertainty in climate projections, including how rising temperatures, changing rainfall, and increased atmospheric carbon dioxide may alter tropical forests’ capacity to absorb carbon.
screening.reason: Climate change and its implications for tropical forests are the central subject. The reporting follows scientists investigating whether volcanic CO2 exposure can shed light on carbon fertilization and the future of the tropical carbon sink.
